# LVGL: Keypad and encoder

This sample runs the keypad and encoder demo that comes with
{doc}`LVGL <../../../third_party/lvgl>`: tabs of widgets that are used
without a pointer. Up and Down move the focus, Select clicks or edits the
focused widget and Back leaves it.

Unlike most samples it does not end.
